meta.title: A user limited to the PR's location and category is shown

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area where PR-1 can be selected.
The case requires PR-1 to be handled from the Open tab.
Select the named PR's line item so the assignment action becomes available.

args.goal: on the Purchase Requisitions Open tab, click the Assign person icon for PR-1, search for User E in the Search a user box, and stop with the matching assignee result visible

steps.note: Perform the assignment search and leave the result visible for assertion.
Assert that the expected user appears in the assignee list.
Assert that the displayed user is the Gurgaon buyer matching the PR's location and category.
